scope: Native evidence for the zlib-patched base pinned by production-runtime-assessment.json. Versus the Node 22.23.4 base recorded in node-22.23.4-runtime-evidence.json, usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libz.so.1.3.1 is the only changed ELF; every other ELF hash is unchanged and stays covered by that evidence and the evidence it cites.

libz.listed_in: trixie-security main/binary-arm64/Packages.xz (sha256 6909fe24f36d4b01b38602ba0809df77b412c0e9284b8af35b934e34a7347616, as listed in trixie-security InRelease)
libz.gz_write_fix: The gzwrite patch, a backport of upstream df84af25 to 1.3.1, resets strm.avail_in and strm.next_in to the internal buffer when gz_comp() fails inside gz_write(). That stale next_in is the defect of CVE-2026-76844; the Debian tracker records it as the same fixing change as CVE-2026-85091.

advisories_fixed.tracker_status: Debian security tracker, 2026-11-12: trixie (security) 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+deb13u1 fixed for CVE-2026-85091 and CVE-2026-76844.

methods.layers: Index, arm64 platform manifests, configs and every layer blob of both images fetched by digest from gcr.io/distroless/nodejs22-debian13 and checked against those digests. Each image's root file system was rebuilt by applying its layers in order with whiteouts; every regular file of 4 or more bytes starting with \x7fELF was hashed with SHA-256, the same rule as scripts/assess-staging-runtime.py, and the two inventories compared.
methods.libz: The .deb's data member was extracted and hashed. Symbols were read with readelf --dyn-syms; imports with elf_imports() from scripts/assess-staging-runtime.py.
methods.signature: The trixie-security InRelease signature was not verified offline (no Debian security key in the local keyring); the package hash chain was checked from InRelease to Packages.xz to the .deb.
